newsitem.title: CHINA: Sales of China truck maker rise 4.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sales of China truck maker rise 4.4 pct.

text.p: The China Heavy Duty Truck Corp had sales of 4.41 billion yuan ($531.32 million) in the first seven months of 1996, up 4.4 percent from the year-earlier period, the Economic Information Daily said on Friday.
The number of vehicles sold rose 3.2 percent and sales of the firm's Sitai'er trucks doubled, the newspaper said. It gave no figures.
The group leased 620 Sitai'er trucks in the period, almost as many as in the whole of last year.
Since May this year, the corporation, based in the eastern city of Jinan, had curbed losses and recorded monthly profits of 100 billion yuan ($12 billion), it said.
The group expected to cut outstanding loans and credit by 1.0 billion yuan each this year and to cut management costs by 20 percent, it said.
